text: hm. also, i click on a piece to skin it, and i click the skin/material, it doesnt apply it though
resolution: Clicking a swatch in the new FacePainter only ARMED the brush; applying required a second click on a face button — to a Sims-builder that reads as 'it doesnt apply'. Fixed in 24fd5a404: picking any swatch (color, material, recent, valid #rrggbb) now paints the WHOLE selection immediately (pieceSkinSet on every slot front/back/sides, one batch = one undo step, ids stay stable), and the face buttons N/E/S/W/Top/In refine a single side with the same brush afterward. Panel title now says so. Bundle clean; no game/ code changed.
